address: SOHO, 2F, City of Dreams, Estrada do Istmo, Cotai, Macau
bio: The casino complex plays host to a plethora of eateries, including this sizeable branch of the international chain. Din Tai Fung is rightly known for its exquisite xiao long bao, handmade on site with a dazzling choice of fillings. Classic palates will relish the pork variety, but shrimps with angled loofah, and hairy crabmeat and roe are also worth trying. Other notables include braised beef noodle soup....
